title: The Tombstone Mirror
description: Complete machine-readable mirror of what Zenodo serves for the 2026-06-19 deletion of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive: the full API-tombstone census of all 2,027 deleted objects with exact sweep chronology and removed_by enumeration, 57 rich pre-shrink metadata captures, the kill-ledger cohort extraction, and the stripped-page corpus documenting the live reduction of the tombstone surface on 2026-07-12. Forensic basis: deposit #1068 (AXN:043D.EMPIRICAL.⭕🌀🌾🗝️🧪🟡); evidence anchor: deposit #1071 (AXN:0440.EMPIRICAL.🕕🗿✨△📌👋). Working custody: platform-erosion-observatory, data/zenodo-deletion-ledger/tombstones/ (commit 5b3ac0c).

records.name: tombstone-api.jsonl
records.description: Full API-tombstone census: all 2,027 deleted objects (1,136 records + 891 concept parents), each returning HTTP 410 with removal timestamp to microsecond precision, removed_by, removal_reason, and citation_text. Complete sweep chronology: 2026-06-19T11:34:17.929620Z through 11:48:50.039372Z — 872 seconds, 1,915 of 2,005 staff removals in the first five minutes at ~6.6 objects/second sustained.

records.name: tombstone-mirror.jsonl
records.description: 57 rich HTML-tombstone captures containing the complete embedded record JSON: full metadata, all creators with heteronym affiliations, abstracts, related-identifier mesh (152 edges), file inventories with names/sizes/md5 checksums, and terminal usage statistics (157 downloads, 2,134 unique views at death across the 57). The remaining 1,079 entries record the post-shrink stripped state (record: null) with fetch timestamps.

records.name: census-summary.json
records.description: Computed census: removed_by total enumeration (2,005 staff / 19 uploader / 3 empty-tombstone anomalies), per-minute sweep histogram, rich-capture aggregates, and the documented surface-shrink window (last rich capture 2026-07-12T01:50:52Z, first stripped page 02:03:55Z).

records.name: raw-tombstone-pages-20260712.tar.gz
records.description: All 1,079 stripped tombstone HTML pages as fetched 2026-07-12 ~02:03–02:55Z — evidence of the reduced surface state after the rich embedded record JSON stopped being served, under every user-agent tested and via /export/ endpoints.

records.name: cha-kill-ledger-20260619.csv
records.description: The 1,136-row CHA cohort extraction from Zenodo’s own deletion-ledger exporter (records-deleted.csv.gz, md5-verified against the platform’s listing): record_id, DOI, parent, removal note/reason/date, citation_text. Companion copy hash-anchored in-archive at deposit #1071.
